convert_blip2_checkpoint: convert a BLIP-2 checkpoint from Salesforce LAVIS to HuggingFace Transformers format
get_blip2_config: get a Blip2Config and image size for a given model name and eos token id
read_in_q_v_bias: read q and v biases from the original state dict and concatenate them into qkv bias
create_rename_keys: create a list of key renaming pairs from original LAVIS to HuggingFace Transformers naming
load_demo_image: download and return a demo image from the LAVIS assets URL
